key_insight: Matlantis PFP v9 expands its r2SCAN training data to 96 elements and additional domains, enabling broader simulations of rare-earth, actinide, cluster, and adsorption systems.
engineering_relevance: Broader chemical coverage and faster inference support larger atomistic simulations for materials and surface engineering.
method: Extend r2SCAN training data to lanthanides Pr–Lu and elements Po–Cm.
Add cluster and adsorption structures to the training coverage.
Evaluate formation and adsorption energies against experiment and benchmark inference against SevenNet-Omni.
evidence_signal: New-element crystal formation energies retain comparable accuracy to previously supported compositions; on A100 GPUs, force evaluation is 3–4× faster and maximum system size is 5–10× larger than SevenNet-Omni.
watch_item: Chemisorbed species are overbound, despite overall adsorption-energy error against experiment being comparable to DFT-PBE.
paper_title: Technical Note on Matlantis PFP v9: Extending the Element and Domain Coverage of the r2SCAN Training Data
